Overview

Nitra is a city in Nitra Region with a population of 77,610. Slovakia’s oldest city, a historic center of the Great Moravian Empire, with a stunning castle, a vibrant university life, and a rich agricultural tradition. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
